accounting_limit: Some earlier startup work, directed audits, unit tests, documented-command checks, bibliography validation, and document work were not included in one lifecycle counter. The first direct tiny-domain prototype also lacked a frozen operation metric. The stated CPU and counted-operation totals are therefore lower bounds, not complete lifecycle measurements.
budget_scope: The implemented plan applies two million counted operations to one frozen campaign. The final campaign uses 1,340,425. Repeated executions exceed two million in aggregate; no lifetime-compliance claim is made.
